patches.reason: 0x00054750 was recovered as its own body (config/recovered-functions.json), so the translation pass's "not detected" trap for the same address became a duplicate symbol: LNK2005 sub_00054750 already defined in recovered.obj. recomp_stubs_unresolved.c is translation-owned, so recover-functions.py cannot remove it (its line 179 says so); this patch is the sanctioned mechanism and scripts/patch-generated.py re-applies it after every regeneration. It implements L02: the recovered body must replace the generated translation for this address. Deletion is written as a replacement to an empty string.

patches.reason: 0x000B5F3A is an internal label of the function at 0x000B5EB0, not an entry. The reviewed manifest no longer carries it, so the generated dispatch tuple for it names a symbol nothing defines and the link fails with LNK2001. Removing the tuple is the whole fix: the widened 0x000B5EB0 body owns the address as a loc_ label reached by fallthrough from its own jump table at 0x000B5F0F.
